summary: This is a reusable Card component that wraps content in a styled container. It accepts optional custom classes, inline styles, shadow effects, and child content, then combines them all together using the clsx utility to build the final className.

explanations.12: The shadow prop can only be one of three specific string values: 'lw' (low), 'md' (medium), or 'tl' (tall) — TypeScript will complain if you pass anything else.
explanations.16: This line checks if a shadow prop was provided; if it was, it builds a class name like 'item shadow--lw' by concatenating strings, otherwise it's an empty string.
explanations.18: clsx() is a utility that combines multiple class name arguments (including conditional ones) into a single string, automatically filtering out falsy values like empty strings.
